static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive band members and friends to confide in, but frustration with gardening once strained relations with teammates
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; no previous psychotherapy or psychiatric visits
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with good logic, can self-reflect, highly cooperative, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I will never have a talent for gardening, because every spider plant I buy dies; this makes me feel frustrated and incompetent.
basic_info.core_demands: When I found that these frustrations were affecting my mood and my enjoyment of gardening and other activities, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Started gardening a year ago, tried raising spider plants, but failed many times; each time seeing dead plants triggers intense frustration and a sense of inadequacy.
As a drummer in an independent band, frequent touring means long time away, unable to water and maintain regularly; this objective limitation makes plant survival harder.

Repeated failures continuously affect the mood, the interest in and pleasure from gardening has declined, pleasure in other activities has diminished, and when getting along with teammates irritability arises more easily, with relationships affected to a certain extent.

To improve results, actively researched gardening techniques, read materials and used plant care apps, but still failed frequently, further reinforcing helplessness and doubts about one's own abilities.

core_beliefs: I am naturally without gardening talent

special_situations.event: Seeing one's spider plant wither again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even keep a spider plant alive, it means I have no ability and no gardening talent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Double down on researching materials, use plant care apps, strictly follow tutorials to prove I can do it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never have gardening talent / I am a failure

special_situations.event: When preparing to care for a new plant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I failed before, this time will surely fail too; past failures determine future outcomes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking materials beforehand, carefully adjusting water, fertilizer, and light, and formulating detailed steps to lower the risk of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, this time will fail again

special_situations.event: Touring away, unable to water on time and do daily maintenance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should be able to raise plants well even while touring frequently; otherwise it proves I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On returning home, concentrates on remedying and over-caring, trying to control outcomes with more frequent checking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is all my responsibility; I should be able to handle it

special_situations.event: Low mood after seeing dead plants, and feeling irritable while rehearsing with bandmates
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Feeling bad now means I really am not competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Talk less about gardening, shift attention to emotional venting (irritability) to briefly relieve helplessness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I feel terrible; this proves I am not suited to raising plants

positive_force: Has persistence and initiative: actively researches materials, uses care apps, willing to learn and improve
Positive attitude; can accept suggestions and is willing to set small goals and practice them step by step
Occupational functioning stable (performances not yet affected); has basic life and work stability
Has supportive teammates and friends, can obtain emotional support when needed
negative_force: Tour itinerary is frequent, objectively making it difficult to provide stable care (situational constraints are significant)
Thinking patterns like overgeneralization and negative prediction reinforce self-denial
'Should'-style self-demands and individualized blame attribution, ignoring external situational factors
Emotional reasoning and irritability after frustration, affecting interpersonal relations and daily enjoyment

target_behavior.behavior: Intense frustration and self-denial in plant-care-related situations, and irritability when interacting with bandmates
antecedent: Trying to start caring for a new plant
Touring away leading to inability to water and care on time
Triggered by the scene to recall multiple past care failures
target_behavior.core_reason: Attributing repeated spider-plant care failures to one's own 'incompetence / lack of talent', forming overgeneralization and negative prediction; meanwhile objective limitations from touring worsen failure experiences and helplessness.
target_behavior.function: Escape feelings of failure and reduce anxiety in the short term (through self-denial, irritable venting, or talking less), gaining temporary emotional release and a sense of control.
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and reduced interest, gardening activities impaired; relationship tension with bandmates; overall daily pleasure declines.
